subject.title: feat: inspect background tasks across web and mobile

question: Should `operator.read` authorize retrieval of bounded task prompt text through `tasks.get` across web and native clients?
rationale: Prompt text can contain sensitive user input and was not previously exposed by task lists or events, so the correct operator scope is a product security decision rather than something tests can settle.

options.title: Keep bounded operator-read details
options.body: Retain the 4,000-character on-demand field under `operator.read`, with focused authorization and prompt-omission tests plus real behavior proof.

options.title: Require operator-admin
options.body: Gate prompt retrieval behind a stronger scope while leaving status and output inspection available to read-only operators.

options.title: Ship without prompts
options.body: Land cross-client status and output inspection but defer prompt exposure until its authorization and privacy contract is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Keep bounded operator-read details
recommendation.body: Retain the 4,000-character on-demand field under `operator.read`, with focused authorization and prompt-omission tests plus real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs with the existing task-ledger RPC surface and its public SDK contract.
